IC1: - Patients who are day -10 pre- to day +30 post-allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant (AHCT) from any donor [OR] or graft source [AND] and for any conditioning regimen
IC2: - Patients who have received treatment with meropenem [OR] or piperacillin-tazobactam (pip-tazo) intravenously (IV) (of at least 24 hours duration) in past 7 days
IC3: - Controlled infection defined as hemodynamically stable [AND] and [NOT] not requiring supplemental oxygen of more than 2 liters via nasal cannula
IC4: - Patients who are able to take oral medications in suspension form
IC5: - Patients who are able to provide informed consent (IC) and comply with all study visits and procedures
